name: LightRAG
description: Builds a graph-based retrieval index over documents so agents can answer questions spanning many sources, served through a standalone API server.

skills.name: Graph Index
skills.description: Builds an entity and relationship graph from raw documents to support multi-hop retrieval.

skills.name: Hybrid Query
skills.description: Combines vector similarity with graph traversal to retrieve context pure embedding search misses.

skills.name: Incremental Update
skills.description: Adds new documents to an existing index without rebuilding the whole knowledge graph.

skills.name: API Serving
skills.description: Serves retrieval over HTTP through a standalone server that agent harnesses can call directly.
